### Home with the Lord
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/home-with-the-lord
Passage: 2 Corinthians 5:1
Points:
- Funerals display only a decaying physical shell, not the believer's true soul.
- The departed believer's spirit is immediately present with the Lord.
- Earthly remains will one day be raised and transformed into glorified eternal bodies.
- Christians have no reason to fear death because their future is full of hope.

### What Does 'Absent from the Body Present with the Lord' Mean in 2 Corinthians 5:8?
Author: Clarence L. Haynes Jr.
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/what-does-absent-from-the-body-present-with-the-lord-mean.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 5:8
Points:
- Believers transition directly into the presence of God the moment physical life ends.
- Earthly bodies are merely temporary tents that will be exchanged for eternal heavenly dwellings.
- The Holy Spirit inside believers provides assurance and dispels the fear of dying.
- The certainty of standing before Christ should motivate believers to walk by faith and honor Him today.
